title: Blood Censor pack (Lime)
description: A blood censor pack that changes redstone block particles often used to simulate blood to be lime
body:
# Tired of seeing blood when punching mobs?
This resourcepack changes that by recolouring the redstone block texture often used to simulate blood on servers
![green blood](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6c8fee5806686117c4c80921fb15c0aba313bd4c.png)
